authority: Requirements planning only; no implementation, new release commitment, schema, sending, billing or payment activation
inspiration: Owner-requested Biller Genie-inspired categories; no claim about that product's current capabilities or integration
existingRelease1Scope: Original README invoicing, schedules, authorized recurring payments, reminders, accounting/reconciliation and customer lifecycle remain required scope. Local internal/sandbox foundations are not operational acceptance. New enhancements below neither replace nor silently enlarge approved release scope.
invariants: Reuse existing customers, service locations, estimates, jobs, invoices, schedules and payment/ledger models
Tenant, property and payer visibility/authority are separate; never infer cross-company or payer access
NMI preferred; Authorize.Net optional and independently bound; neither activated
No financial execution or outbound communication from synthetic consent/preferences
UNKNOWN payment/delivery outcomes are held and reconciled, never automatically retried
Keep approved customer/contractor presentation and all migration/P1/recovery/Netlify gates

requirements.existing: Internal branded invoices, invoiceBalance/verifyLedger, synthetic receivable/capture/refund events and reconciliation foundations
newRequirements: Read-only tenant receivable overview, aging/as-of currency-aware filters and source drilldown
Explicit balance freshness, disputed/held/unknown states and staff review queues without new postings
requirements.dependencies: Genuine invoice/credit/payment/schedule source semantics, permission matrix, as-of/aging policy and reconciliation truth; never add a second ledger
requirements.acceptance: Balances reconcile to existing source IDs/currencies/as-of date; no forecast/unknown payment counted as settled; tenant/payer negatives

requirements.existing: README reminder intent, internal message sink, tenant branded preparation, consent/suppression and delivery evidence foundations; real sending disabled
newRequirements: Recheck current authorized invoice balance, credits, disputes and in-flight/UNKNOWN payments immediately before preparing/sending a reminder
Deduplicate reminder identity, apply approved cadence/timezone/recipient policy and stop on unknown delivery
requirements.dependencies: Authoritative balance and consent/sender/suppression, durable outbox/provider delivery/reconciliation, approved cadence and exact send authorization
requirements.acceptance: Paid/credited/held/uncertain items do not generate misleading demands; duplicate/lost-response tests; no actual send in local demo

requirements.feature: Multi-property billing and authorized payer relationships
requirements.existing: Customers/service locations and explicit customer/property access exist; invoices reference an existing customer and immutable scope
newRequirements: Explicit bill-to payer/delegate authority distinct from property viewer/owner and staff membership
Reviewable per-property allocations and statement grouping without replacing original invoice identities or double-counting balances
requirements.suggestedPlacement: PROPOSED_LATER_ENHANCEMENT; owner may separately select a narrower Release1 package
requirements.dependencies: Payer delegation/revocation/consent and invoice allocation design, independent privacy/schema/financial review
requirements.acceptance: A viewer cannot pay/authorize/view another payer's documents by relationship inference; allocations sum exactly without duplicate debt

requirements.feature: Recurring maintenance billing and controlled autopay
requirements.existing: README recurring agreements/authorized recurring payments, inspection cadence, proposed schedules and provider intent/idempotency foundations; no operational recurrence/autopay
newRequirements: Billing recurrence tied to separately authorized agreement/service period, never inferred from an inspection plan
Explicit merchant/payer/token/amount/date mandate, limits, cancellation/revocation and failure/UNKNOWN hold controls
requirements.suggestedPlacement: PROPOSED_LATER_ENHANCEMENT; baseline recurring-payment requirement stays on existing acceptance list
requirements.dependencies: Genuine agreement, mandate/token custody, provider-specific recurring support, reviewed fee/tax/rail rules and exact execution authorization
requirements.acceptance: No charge on cadence/visit/maintenance review alone; ceiling/period/duplicate/revocation/UNKNOWN tests and independent provider acceptance

requirements.existing: Estimate proposed deposit/milestone/dated schedules and internal test one-time payment authorizations; not a customer negotiation workflow
newRequirements: Version-specific customer request and staff review/counterproposal against exact existing invoice/scope
Retain original debt/schedule until separately authorized replacement; request never grants a mandate or changes balances
requirements.suggestedPlacement: PROPOSED_LATER_ENHANCEMENT; local request-only UX could be separately scoped after Workstream3
requirements.dependencies: Reviewed schedule amendment, eligibility/dispute/consent policy, legal/financial review before operative terms
requirements.acceptance: Rejected/pending/countered requests have no financial effect; integer installment totals/dates and exact payer/version access verified

requirements.existing: README accounting exports/reconciliation, existing ledger and exact-ID/currency/amount reconcileStatement adapter; genuine settlement acceptance absent
newRequirements: External accounting system mapping, one-way/two-way direction, idempotent export/import IDs, conflict/credit/refund policy
Provider/bank batch-fee/net-settlement matching with suspense exceptions and manual review, without altering original transaction evidence
requirements.suggestedPlacement: PROPOSED_LATER_ENHANCEMENT_CONNECTORS; baseline reconciliation remains required Release1 acceptance
requirements.dependencies: Owner-selected accounting target, provider statements/accounts/credentials and exact call authority, mapping/settlement/timezone policy and independent accounting review
requirements.acceptance: No text/amount-only ambiguous match, double posting or inferred settlement; mismatch/duplicate/out-of-order/UNKNOWN remain reviewable

nextProductDecision: Owner selects exact enhancement scope/release placement; until then all six are PROPOSED and AR implementation/execution remains held
